# PetalWild asset hunt

Date: 2026-09-22
Hunter: PETAL-13

Only CC0 assets with a licence stated on the publisher page, API, or the file shipped inside the download were kept. MIT, BSD, and Apache were allowed; none of the kept files used those licences.

Download total: 26864773 bytes (25.62 MiB), under the 40 MB budget. Zip archives were extracted and the zip copies were not kept, so each row below is an extracted file.

### Poly Haven ground textures (1K JPG)

- Licence page: https://polyhaven.com/license

- Forest Leaves 02: https://polyhaven.com/a/forest_leaves_02
